title: Grateful Dead Live at Utica Memorial Auditorium on 1973-03-21

ai_review.summary: Good‑ish Betty Cantor soundboard captures a high‑energy early‑73 show with standout Dark Star, Eyes of the World and a mind‑blowing Jack Straw.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its soaring Dark Star, fiery Eyes of the World, sunshine‑filled Box of Rain and especially the blazing keyboards on Jack Straw.  The Betty Cantor soundboard is generally solid but suffers from occasional mix quirks – low vocals, a bit too loud Bob, and some water‑damage distortion on Eyes of the World.  Overall listeners find the show exhilarating despite those technical blemishes.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the musical performance 4‑5 stars and highlight several classic jams, while recording comments note average to good soundboard quality with some mix issues; weighted average yields a ~4‑star rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear Betty Cantor board but with noted low vocal levels, occasional Bob‑vocals dominance, Jerry’s guitar sometimes buried, and water‑damage distortion on Eyes of the World; not a pristine master but fully listenable.

poor_songs: Eyes of the World (distracted in a few reviews)
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set builds with sunshine‑filled tunes and solid Box of Rain; second set launches into an intense Dark Star that segues into Eyes of the World, delivering a powerful, improvisational peak before winding down with classic ballads.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Generally praised for his jam energy, though some note his guitar gets buried in the mix and vocals are low at times.
band_member_comments.Phil: Strong vocal work on Box of Rain; noted for joking about St. Stephen no‑longer being played.
band_member_comments.Bob: His vocals sometimes too forward in the mix; otherwise contributes solid rhythm and occasional lead moments.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith/Brent keyboards receive high praise, especially the soaring solo on Jack Straw and overall “mind‑blowing” key work.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill’s drumming is highlighted as a driving force for the improvisations, especially during Dark Star.
